INSERT INTO governance.missions (mission_key, title, status, started_at)
VALUES ('{{$json.mission_key}}', {{$json.title ? ''' + $json.title.replace(/'/g, '\'\'') + ''' : 'NULL'}}, 'execution', now())
ON CONFLICT (mission_key) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title
RETURNING id AS mission_id, mission_key;

WITH repos AS (
  SELECT unnest(ARRAY[{{ $json.repos.map(r => ''' + r.replace(/'/g, '\'\'') + ''').join(',') }}]::text[]) AS repo_key
)
INSERT INTO governance.repositories (repo_key, repo_url, default_branch, active)
SELECT repo_key, NULL, 'main', true
FROM repos
ON CONFLICT (repo_key) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, repo_key;

WITH m AS (
  SELECT id AS mission_id FROM governance.missions WHERE mission_key = '{{$node['Validate + Auth'].json['mission_key']}}'
), r AS (
  SELECT id AS repo_id, repo_key
  FROM governance.repositories
  WHERE repo_key = ANY(ARRAY[{{ $node['Validate + Auth'].json.repos.map(r => ''' + r.replace(/'/g, '\'\'') + ''').join(',') }}]::text[])
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO governance.mission_tasks (mission_id, repo_id, task_key, status, assigned_agent, started_at)
  SELECT m.mission_id, r.repo_id, 'inventory', 'pending', 'unassigned', now()
  FROM m CROSS JOIN r
  ON CONFLICT (mission_id, repo_id, task_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT mission_id FROM m) AS mission_id,
  ARRAY(SELECT id FROM governance.mission_tasks WHERE mission_id = (SELECT mission_id FROM m) ORDER BY created_at) AS task_ids;
